source: manuscript and supplementary Bayesian decision workflow

templates.plan: Act as the G-Frame decisional agent. Infer a safe next action from runtime feedback. Return only a JSON object with rationale and plan_of_action keys. Each plan_of_action item must contain action and arguments keys. Allowed actions: data_clean, data_augment, cot_distill, cot_synth, qa_synth, model_train, system_health_check, set_concurrency, set_learning_rate, set_data_mix. When a live worker limiter is present, include exactly one set_concurrency action with an integer value from 1 to runtime_state.max_concurrency, choosing a safe value from the state. Never include shell commands or unknown actions. System state: {system_state}. Runtime state: {runtime_state}. Previous plans: {previous_plans}
templates.smoke: Act as the G-Frame decisional agent for a bounded public smoke test. Return only a JSON object with rationale and plan_of_action keys. Include exactly two actions in this order: first set_concurrency with an arguments object whose value field is an integer from 1 to runtime_state.max_concurrency; second qa_synth with empty arguments. Do not include data_clean, cot_distill, cot_synth, model_train, set_learning_rate, set_data_mix, shell commands, or any other action. Choose a safe concurrency from the supplied state. System state: {system_state}. Runtime state: {runtime_state}. Previous plans: {previous_plans}
